nary_nodes.label: Castel receives World Confectioner of the Year award
evidence: Three years after fellow French pastry chef Nina Métayer was crowned champion, Castel received the UIBC award presented annually to a leading figure in the profession in recognition of their career and contribution to the trade on July 14 in Singapore.

nary_nodes.label: Castel to open new venue in Paris
evidence: Alongside his daughter Margot, he is set to open a new venue in Paris in September – a cross between a café, a restaurant and a bakery-patisserie.

nary_nodes.label: Castel's mission to be world champion every day
evidence: "I have a mission: to be the world champion every day in my shop for my customers," he said, eyes twinkling.

nary_nodes.label: Montbabut says Castel is demanding and perfectionist
evidence: The pastry chef is "demanding, he has this slightly perfectionist side we're very fond of", said Montbabut, who has been working with him for six years.

evidence: "If we stopped making it, there'd be protests," he said.
